_comment: Content-wise this site is identical in structure to site_a, but robots.txt
disallows the AI retrieval bots (OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot,
Claude-SearchBot) across the whole site, and it also has genuine downstream
defects: no JSON-LD anywhere, a thin page, and a generic title.
A flat checklist reports every downstream defect at full severity.
Expected output here is ONE critical (reach.robots.ai_search_bot_blocked)
plus downstream discoverability findings CAPPED at medium and tagged
blocked_by, and all engagement checks running normally and UNAFFECTED,
because gate Rule 0 does not gate the act stage on reach.
The wildcard group still allows us, so we can lawfully crawl and observe
the downstream defects. That separation is the whole point: the bots that
matter are blocked, our auditor is not.
